steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Fang Xiaoshi! What are you doing up on the rafters?! Get down here this instant!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: This is the Yishan Temple, so take your antics anywhere else but here!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Not a chance!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: The village is so big, why did you have to dump this lousy temple on our family's land? You're just bullying us! Zhou Liu, why not dump it at your place instead?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: You know nothing, brat. The temple has been protecting Moushan Village for a thousand years, you don't just pick it up and move it.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: The entire village agreed to this arrangement, it's not up to you!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Bah!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Didn't this land used to be completely barren? Why didn't you say the feng shui was good then? You're telling me after all these years my dad worked to make the soil fertile, the feng shui just happened to improve at the same time?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'll come out and say it, you thought you could step up and bully the only outsiders in this village. Well, let me tell you, you're wrong!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad might just take it, but I sure won't!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You want the temple to protect the harvest? Well, I wanna blow it up so we can actually grow something to eat!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: You wouldn't dare—

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So many faces showing up at your door upon your return. I've only seen that happen to gamblers.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Well, I guess you were talking at least a little truth on the way here. The villagers certainly don't want you around.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That's why I told you to not bring me here.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But you never said why exactly...

The small yard is packed full of people, but none of the villagers move to start a conversation. They just stare at Qiubai and Fang Xiaoshi like the two of them are strange new beasts they can't let out.
*cough* *cough* Let... me through...
What's everyone bumbling about here for? Even Xiaoshi's manyue wasn't this lively...
A thin and tall man stumbles out from the crowd with labored breaths. His back, carrying a log, is as bent as the bow at his hip.
The man sights Fang Xiaoshi and freezes for a second, before quickly averting his gaze and slowly turning away.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad...

steps.name: Nervous Villager
steps.text: Hunter...

steps.name: Nervous Villager
steps.text: Hey, don't you forget our agreement...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I don't forget.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: But Xiaoshi has been away from home for three whole years. He should have something to eat first, shouldn't he?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Let's head back. We can sort things out with the village later.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: The fieldwork's already been lagging lately. In just a few days, Chunfen will have been and gone.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: All that babbling on the way here, and you turn mute in front of your dad?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad... I found you.
The hunter presses his pale lips together, and without answering his son goes into the house, setting his log against the wall.
The boy freezes in place. Qiubai prods him with the hilt of her sword.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Please, Miss, have a seat. Thanks for bringing the kid home, I'm sure it took some effort. And please, have a drink.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No need. I don't want to interrupt the reunion.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'll take a look around the village.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'll give you the tour...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You stay put.
Miss, Miss... if I could have just a moment?

steps.name: Amiable Old Man
steps.text: Zhou Liu is out there talking about a heroic heroine who brought Fang Xiaoshi home, so I had to see for myself.

steps.name: Amiable Old Man
steps.text: Taking a look at you, you must be...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I am called Qiubai, from Jianghu.

steps.name: Amiable Old Man
steps.text: Everyone here in Moushan is of the Zhou Clan. I am Zhou Shun, village headman and Clan Elder.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Our village is tucked away here in the northwest reaches of Yan, so we hardly ever see strangers.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Rest assured. I'm nothing but a Jianghu wanderer. I have no ill intent.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Oh, Miss, that's not what I meant to imply...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I happened to come across the boy out on his own, so I took a little detour and brought him back here.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Miss, you're a chivalrous one.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Dear guest from afar, a poor village like ours has nothing much to offer, but if you don't mind...
A few meters away from them stands a well.
Something crashes into the bucket above the well, sending it to the bottom.
A long sword juts out to hold the mechanism in place, pulling the rope taut.
Qiubai drags the bucket up.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Just a scared little burdenbeast.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Looks like the one from Zhou Dazhi's place...

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Its mother died in childbirth, leaving this poor thing to grow up alone, so it's as tame as can be. It probably just got startled.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's not hurt, at least. Seems like it passed out from all the water.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Oh, about that... how did you move to the well so fast? I feel like my vision blurred for a moment...

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Was that kung fu?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The well is full of muddy water.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Yes... it was raining heavily last week, and the mud has yet to settle.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: *sigh*, the last two years of drought have seen most of our crops wither away.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No wonder there are so many wells around the village.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Heaven can be very unreasonable at times. We either get nary a drop, or a nigh disastrous deluge.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Miss Qiu, where did you come here from?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Yumen.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: But I believe I detect Jiangqi accent...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I was born there.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: I see... If you came from Yumen, you must have entered the village from the north. Head further south, and you'll find a section of the Chidao washed away by a mudslide.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Life is hard here.
With two raucous grunts, the young burdenbeast wakes up. The swordswoman loosens her grip, and it bolts around a corner in a blink, leaving nothing but a withered acacia tree in front of her.
It's already late March, but spring has apparently not yet come to this small, northwestern village.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Indeed, this is a perilous place. You said you came across the boy all alone? He must have gone through a lot after leaving the village.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Miss, I'd like to ask you something... what sort of trouble did the lad get up to out there?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No trouble to speak of. He was just lost out in the wilderness.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: That boy has been particularly rowdy, ever since he was little.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Elder, I have some questions about Fang Xiaoshi.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The villagers... they seem hostile toward the boy?
After a long period of silence, the man turns around and goes into a back room. He soon returns with a pile of beasthides and bones.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Take these.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad? What for?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: This is all we have. Spring has barely come, so prey has been scarce. But they're still worth something. Give them to her as payment.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Is it not enough?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: We don't have anything else, so I guess I'll beg her for mercy... although she doesn't seem like the talkative type.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: She's not a debt collector!

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You must've stolen or broken something, why else would she walk you all the way back here?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Do you really think I can't do anything right?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You've done more than a little wrong...

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: Tian ah! This door... this pillar... it's been split in two...

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: The temple stood here for centuries, protecting us, but it's been ruined... such disrespect!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Well, it's lucky the ancestral tablet seems mostly fine. Enough kowtowing already, let's find whoever did this.

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: Say... Where's Fang Xiaoshi? Gone without a trace...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: I think the kid got caught up in the explosion, I saw him bleeding and limping out of the village. He had so many bombs on him... serves him right.

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: All for a piece of land we could have negotiated over. We definitely could have resolved this peacefully.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Alright, alright. Go tell the Elder, I'll head to the hunter's place.

steps.name: Astonished Villager
steps.text: Didn't you say he ran away from the village?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: The kid was hurt pretty bad. I'd better get the hunter to look for him!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: He blew up the village temple with his own explosives?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Three years ago... he was probably just eleven or twelve years old?

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: His father sometimes hunted with explosives to cave in beast nests and such. That child is as smart as he is audacious, and must've figured out how to make them too.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: From my personal experience... this certainly seems like something he would do.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's the temple at the village entrance, isn't it? It looked pretty unique, even at a glance. Who's it dedicated to?

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Our very ancestors.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Back in the day... eight hundred years ago, or a thousand? How long ago exactly, I'm not so sure myself. The story has been passed down from generation to generation, after all.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Anyway, in those times, there was nothing here but mountains, so dense that not even fowlbeasts could fly over.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Our ancestor, alone and armed with only a hoe, dug out a mountain and turned it into arable land, eventually forming this village.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: You should have seen it on the way here, Miss? Barren land in all directions, as far as the eye can see, but here we manage to farm and feed our hundred or so people. We're sheltered from most Catastrophes.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: He took a hoe and plowed out a living from Heaven itself.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: We call it the Yishan Temple, in thanks to our benevolent ancestor, and to commemorate that he lives on in us forever.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: This here temple has blessed our Moushan village with a thousand years of peace and quiet.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: We all know that a few measly buildings made of wood and dirt won't affect the harvest at all.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: But us Moushan villagers have lived like this for generations. We have our nostalgia, and it puts our minds at ease.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad, iff you want to yell at me, just do it.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: The way you're staring at me, it's awkward.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You've grown tall, but not much otherwise.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You must not have been eating well while out there, all these years.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Of all the things to say...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: As long as you're alive... that's all that matters... I was just worried...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: How did you make your way here?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: We walked along the Chidao, and occasionally hitched a ride with merchant caravans we came across, hopping on their burdenbeasts.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: How long was the journey?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Probably about a month.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You went so far...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: All these years, you...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Barely making a living

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: The harvest has been getting worse these past few years. First, an infestation destroyed our crops. Then came the drought, Heaven refused to give us a single drop of water, not from the sky, not from the wells, no matter how many we dug.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: And now this year, Chunfen has come. It's the right time for sowing, but then we face a brutal storm.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Who knows if the land has always been this temperamental, or if Heaven has turned against us.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Or maybe the village ancestors refuse to bless us...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: And it's because I blew up that temple. That's what you want to say, right?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: That's not what I meant...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That's what a lazy person would say.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: 'Farming is all about working the soil with the tool in your hand.' That's what you told me.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: The idol in the temple can't move, how could it help us with the harvest?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: We can't say things like that... we've got to talk it through with them. Besides, we're the ones who wronged them first...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad, the villagers bully you because they think you're a coward!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What about the mountains slowly eating up the fields? Sooner or later, even the temple is going to get washed away by a mudslide. It's just a monument, why not put it in Zhou Liu's backyard? He has so much room and he's not even growing anything.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: They bully us because we're outsiders!

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: *sigh* Let's just drop it already, alright...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I see, so that's why the villagers had such a visceral reaction to Fang Xiaoshi.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Well, not exactly.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: We all thought the boy was already...

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: He was injured when he fled into the wilderness after blowing up the temple.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Did you not look for him?

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: We did.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: I gathered a party overnight and we spent several days searching dozens of li, to no avail.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: I hear the villages of Jiangnan stand out like bright lights in the darkness.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: But for us here, in the mountains, all you see is gray and yellow, or boundless white in winter. Settlements look more like perfect hiding spots.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Beasts roam freely, so the roads are not safe. Sometimes, you even run into fleeing bandits.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: So a boy that small, hurt so badly...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Is still alive and well. Seems like the kid has been through a lot.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: As long as he is safe.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Elder, I have something to say...

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Please, speak freely.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I happened across Fang Xiaoshi, and brought him here. I have no reason to meddle in your village's affairs.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: However, since I took on the initiative to bring him back, I am also responsible for his safety.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: ...As you should be.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I can't say I'm good at reading people, but after having traveled with him for a while, I at least understand him a little.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: He may be stubborn and willful, but he is by no means a bad person.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So I hope you won't make things difficult for him.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Oh, I thought you were going to say something else.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Please, rest assured, Miss. We Moushan villagers may be poor, but we are reasonable people.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: To hold a grudge... who or what exactly should we hold a grudge against? The mountains, Heaven, or...

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: A little boy around ten years old?

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: As you said, life is hard here. Moving the temple was just to put the villagers' minds at ease. Though now when I think about it, we were indeed quite inconsiderate at the time.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: That is to say, I'm the one at fault here.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You are a man of sense.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You don't have to explain it all to me. After all, Fang Xiaoshi did do wrong. If still hasn't matured, even after so much hardship these last three years, he will have to be disciplined.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Make mistakes, suffer the consequences, remember your actions and gain insight. That makes life less painful.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: You're very perceptive.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Not really.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I have my explanation, and I'm relieved.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Yes, yes...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Yes, I bombed the temple. And after three years I, Fang Xiaoshi, have returned. If they can't get over that, they can come find me.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Even now, today, I still want to blow the thing up.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Fine, go do it! Blow it to pieces!

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Three years ago, your nerve was as high Heaven itself, and now three years later, it's soared even higher.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: What did you come back for? Just to blow it up and run away again?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'm done talking, Dad.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What did you bring that log in for anyway?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: ...I'm making a coffin.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Your father's health is failing with each passing day, and all the money I saved for my burial went to rebuild the temple.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I didn't know if you were dead or alive, so I... I thought I should at least make my own coffin while I could.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Hey, come on, no need to talk like that...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I spent a whole month looking for you.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I was hurt. I passed out near the Chidao...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You sure are smart.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: A caravan carrying goods from the mountains found me and threw me onto the back of some burdenbeast carrying fodder. By the time I came to, I was already in a nomadic city.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: It's lucky some good people found you, and not a pack of beasts.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: What happened after you healed up?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I, I decided to make a name for myself before coming back.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Why aren't you asking me what I did in the city?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: If you actually accomplished something, there wouldn't have been a swordswoman escorting you home.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I said it before, you can't bear to live here, but I'm afraid you'll suffer even more if you go out to a town or nomadic city. Returning with your life intact is already a blessing to me.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I've never been to a city, so I have no idea of what it's like. When you feel like talking about it, you can let me know.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: So, are you going to cause a ruckus this time?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Only if they bully us.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: You're still so stubborn...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: The day you ran away, the Elder gathered up the whole village to help me look for you.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: I live here alone, but the villagers don't give me a hard time. That plot of land you keep bringing up, haven't I been tending to it even now?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That just means they have some shred of conscience left in them.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Can you just promise your dad one thing?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Just stay here for good... and don't make a fuss about it...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Fine, whatever you say.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: So you're leaving? Going to Jiangnan?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I have places to be. Bringing you back here has already delayed my journey by a lot.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Then there's no harm in delaying it a while more, right? It's dark already. Why not rest here a few more days and teach me some kung fu before you go!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Didn't I teach you enough on the way here?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad, let's...

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Miss, thank you so much for bringing my boy home. We have nothing to repay you with...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Since you're in a hurry, I won't pressure you to stay.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Fang Xiaoshi, we may have met by chance, but I have some parting words for you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The Jianghu can be vicious, and you have learned something, whether you wanted to or not. But now that you're home, you should make your peace and avoid causing any more trouble.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Hmph, I can make a name for myself wherever I am. One day, in Jiangnan, you'll hear all about the valiant Fang Xiaoshi's deeds!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: As long as I don't hear of you making mischief.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And whoever you trouble next, she may not be as forgiving as I am.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You, forgiving...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Oh hey, can you say that line the heroes always say... the one in all the novels...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: 'Jianghu zai jian.'

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Jianghu zai jian. See you around, kid.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Miss, let me see you off.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No need to trouble yourself.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: We haven't done any work on the roads for a long time, so they're full of holes. I'll guide you to the gate.
Qiubai walks at a brisk pace, and the old man quickens his steps to catch up, ending the conversation.
The sky gradually turns dark. It may be strange to ordinary folk, but Jianghu adventurers prefer to travel at night, using the darkness to their advantage.
The newly raised grave at the entrance of the village is stubby and inconspicuous, hardly visible in the twilight.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Zhou Si, is everyone here?

steps.name: Bystander Villager
steps.text: I'll count again, Elder.

steps.name: Bystander Villager
steps.text: Aside from Dayuan who stepped on his plow out in the fields today and couldn't make it, everyone else is here.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: The whole village is here, Dad? Isn't this a bit much for a welcoming party?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: We're not Zhous, after all. Even when they had that meeting at the temple back then, there was nothing for us.

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: Considering what's happened today, and how we're mixed up in it...
Three years later, Fang Xiaoshi stands once again before the temple. This time there are no explosives, and the man beside him is even older.

The wall he blew up has already been rebuilt and the statue of the mountain digger repaired, but the craftsmanship is a little lacking, and upon seeing this slightly amusing sight Fang Xiaoshi carelessly lets out a laugh.
There are several broken tiles on the floor, with bugs in the still-damaged ceiling forming layers and layers of webbing that blends into the wood.
Perhaps it is too dark to be certain, but he can't figure out if the temple was impossible to renovate, or if it was successfully repaired but has gradually returned to a dilapidated state.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: So, this is where we stand now.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Xiaoshi has apologized. He was still a child then, and the hunter has spent the last three years doing his best to help rebuild the Yishan temple.

steps.name: Bystander Villager
steps.text: Come on, Elder. Let's get to the point already.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Hunter, how many years has it been since you first came to the village?

steps.name: Hunter
steps.text: This year-end, it'll be twenty one.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Your family is the only one with a different name, but you married a daughter of ours, so all these years you have been a part of our family.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Let our previous bumps in the road, misunderstandings and conflicts, all stay in the past.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: From this day forward, the clan officially accepts you into our family and our ancestors will bless you with peace and prosperity as well.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Xiaoshi may change his family name to Zhou too, if he so wishes.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What are you trying to pull this time...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Nuh-uh, I like my own name just fine. Why would I change it?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Elder, just come out and say what you mean already.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: In the end... we are all one family, and that means we face our challenges together.

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: I gathered the whole village here today, to make one request:

steps.name: Clan Elder
steps.text: Xiaoshi, for the sake of the village... can you pretend to be dead?
